text:
rachel: FYI eu-central-1 GPU nodes failing to decrypt keystore during bootstrap after we tightened VPC egress ACLs for cross-account endpoints this morning :warning:
infra-bot: ALERT: keystore-decrypt-failure eu-central-1 3113337765 \u000b 14 nodes failing to reach keystore
sam: logs?
rachel: snippet from kubelet on a failed node:
```
2026-05-10T06:12:10Z kubelet: keystore client: KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:999888777666:key/eeff-1122
2026-05-10T06:12:10Z bootstrap: failing fast, marking node for retry
```
vik: key policy change 3113336000 rolled yesterday, it's supposed to allow cross-account decrypt from privatelink service principal. security-bot: Policy update KP-2026-05-09 applied 3113336000.
nora: question: are we blocking the privatelink endpoint IPs with the new ACL? I saw a deny rule for 100.64.0.0/10 on the control-plane route tables.
sam: confirmed: ACL rule denies 100.64.0.0/10 outbound on subnet-controlplane-eu. privatelink uses carrier-range in that block in our region. that would TCP reset the connections before TLS.
infar-bot: autoscaler behaviour: scaled up then nodes stuck NotReady, then scaled down -> warm pool oscillation and capacity gap. customer-facing RPS degraded briefly.
billing-bot: cost impact estimate: churned replacements + reboots increased instance-hour usage and data transfer retries, rough +19% hour-over-hour for eu-central-1 burst.
vik: quick mitigation options: 1) add ACL allow for privatelink cidr on control-plane subnets 2) add a short-lived route to privatelink endpoint via a dedicated subnet 3) bake local keystore cache into AMI for faster restart resilience
rachel: preference for option 1 + 3 as immediate + medium term. we need to be careful with ACLs so we don't open broad ranges.
sam: ACL change command: `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0aa11bb22 --ingress --rule-number 110 --protocol tcp --port-range From=443,To=443 --cidr-block 100.64.0.0/10 --rule-action allow`  I'll prepare a very narrow rule to the privatelink endpoint prefix instead of the whole carrier block.
nora: security note: any temporary allow must be filed with change id CHG-KE-311333 and include a TTL. security-bot: Temporary exception CHG-KE-311333 created; auto-revert in 40m unless extended. Please attach audit justification.
billing-bot: tag any infra changes with cost-tag: keystore-mitigation-eu to track delta.
vik: applied ACL patch as `acl-patch-3113337802` and opened port 443 to privatelink prefix. monitoring nodes now.
infra-bot: 3113337820: ACL patch applied by sam. validation: fetching node join metrics
rachel: nodes coming up: 3 -> 12 in 3m. still 2 failing due to stale instance profile tokens.
sam: will push a quick AMI bump with local keystore cache and a kubelet boot retry backoff to reduce churn. patch id ami-bootcache-3113337850.
nora: security reminder: follow-up postmortem required due to policy/ACL intersection causing outage risk. include why privatelink ranges were not covered in the original ACL audit.
vik: opening INFRA-4377 with timeline, commands, cost impact, and remediation: add privatelink CIDR mapping to ACL templates, add keystore offline cache to bootstrap, add canary test for privatelink connectivity in rollout jobs.
rachel: thanks. eng-platform/eng-sre to monitor warm-pool metrics for 2h and confirm no regressions.
infra-bot: monitoring window 40m open. provisional mitigations in place. :white_check_mark:
